messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired for service `inference-runtime-latency` (PD-81234). Trigger: p95 latency > 900ms for 3m. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc123/inference?orgId=1
Sam (oncall): acking — on it. grabbing graphs
Maya (sre): I see a sharp p95 jump in eu-west1 around +2m, p50 barely moved. Could be a noisy canary. No major error increase in prod logs.
Kevin (infra): checking autoscaler logs and router CPU on the affected fleet. `kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide` shows a couple of pods restarting in the eu-west1 pool around the spike.
Sam (oncall): can we confirm customer impact? Any 5xxs?
Alyssa (support): no incoming tickets yet, prod-error-rate alert not firing. A few internal healthchecks flagged timeouts from synthetic-agent-eu-canary.
Maya (sre): grafana snapshot: ```p95: 1200ms -> back to 420ms within 90s
error_rate: +0.02% transient
requests_from: synthetic-canary-eu-west1```
Maya (sre): looks like single canary origin, noisy synthetic run. I'll mute PD for this specific check and mark as noisy-source in alerts.
Sam (oncall): trying a targeted PD silence: `pd silence add --service PD-81234 --description "noisy canary; auto-silence" --duration 15m`
ops-bot: Silence created (ID S-5532) for PD-81234, expires in 15m.
Kevin (infra): one node had oom-kill and restarted a worker (oom_score 988). Eviction caused KV cache warmup; transient latencies while warm. Node: gke-eu-prod-17. Investigating memory pressure patterns.
Maya (sre): rolling restart prevented? Looks like oom -> pod restart -> small kv-warmup hit. Not seeing a systemic issue.
Sam (oncall): PD incident shows as acknowledged by Sam. Notifying oncall rotation handoff in 30m in case flapping continues.
incident-bot: PD-81234 auto-resolved (PagerDuty) — incident closed after metrics stabilized.
Maya (sre): marking as no-customer-impact, root cause: transient canary + single-node oom leading to KV cache warm. Action items: (1) add memory headroom alert on gke-eu-prod pool, (2) throttle synthetic canary schedule, (3) add KV cache warm metrics to main dashboard.
Alyssa (support): I'll draft a quick internal note for CS: "no user-facing impact; brief canary flapping in eu-west1"
Sam (oncall): handing off to next oncall — if you see repeat pages, escalate to infra. tagging next: @kevin
Kevin (infra): acked. I'll look at node memory policy and set a mitigator for noisy restarts (pod QoS/oom protection).
Maya (sre): adding runbook note: when PD shows single-region p95 spike with synthetic origin, check `synthetic-canary-*` and node oom events before escalating.
Sam (oncall): thanks everyone. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
